text:
mason: Quick heads-up — running a simulated breach dry-run in the private VPC next Tue 03/31 09:00 UTC. Goal: validate isolation, netpols, KMS access for ephemeral credentials, and audit log continuity. Need sign-off: RBAC changes, KMS key usage, and incident playbook readiness.

elaine: timeline + blast-radius? who will run the exploit sim?

mason: small red-team script only hitting model-serving control-plane. Non-prod tenant in airgapped stack. Blast radius limited to tenant namespace and jumpbox. We'll NOT touch production keys. :lock:

samir: re KMS — are we using existing CMKs or an ephemeral key per-run? concern: decrypt permissions for ops service account.

mason: plan is to use an ephemeral key (rotate-on-create) in customer KMS with policy allowing only the runner role to kms:Decrypt for 1 hour. After run we'll schedule key disable + schedule deletion. Need CR for that.

elaine: RBAC changes: what roles need temp elevation? can we use bounded sts assume-role with MFA?

mason: propose sts:AssumeRole with session tags and duration 1h; no static perms change. We'll add conditional allow with aws:PrincipalTag for 'breach-sim=1'. Audit logs must capture AssumeRole, KMS:Decrypt, and network egress flows.

security-bot: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/priv-breach-dryrun-v1 — checklists + required approvals.

ops-oncall: maintenance window ok 09:00-11:00 UTC. also double-check egress whitelists for jumpbox: outbound to our attack harness IP only. Update netpol example:

```yaml
kind: NetworkPolicy
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: restrict-attack-jump
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: jumpbox
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 198.51.100.42/32
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

mason: we'll also enable packet capture for 2 mins during run. logs to be sent to secure-bucket with server-side encryption and KMS key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/EXAMPLEKEYID

samir: verify CloudTrail and our local audit-agent will not sample-drop these events. Also confirm index retention for 90d for postmortem.

elaine: vuln triage: if exploit finds escalation vector, immediate steps?

mason: stop the sim, revoke session tokens, disable ephemeral key, collect forensics snapshot (namespaces, pod lists, audit logs, network pcaps), escalate to IR channel #incidents and open P1 in tracker.

security-bot: incident playbook invoked on P1.automated: https://internal.redwood/incidents/playbooks/priv-breach

ops-oncall: one more — ensure alerting on kms:Decrypt anomalies + assumeRole outside business hours.

samir: noted. I'll prepare a small IAM doc + policy snippet and attach before EOD.

mason: thanks — please ack if you approve the plan and I'll file the change request.

elaine: ack from me. :thumbsup:

samir: ack.

ops-oncall: ack. I'll be on-call.

security-bot: approval_checklist: approvals: [sec,ops,product]; status: pending sec lead sign-off.

End.
